# Test images

Inputs for `seamcli`, the benchmarks (C2), the graph-cut comparison (C3, C4) and the report figures (R1, R2, R4, R5).
**Owner:** Shee Yang. If you want to add, replace or rename an image, tell Shee Yang first, because the report
tables and the benchmark CSVs refer to these files by name.

## Source and licence

All five images were **generated with ChatGPT** (AI image generation) on 2026-11-10, so there is no third-party
photographer or website to credit. They were generated by a team member for this assignment and are shared here
for it. Each use of an AI tool must also appear in [`docs/ai-usage.md`](../docs/ai-usage.md) and in the report's
AI Usage Declaration; the prompts are listed below.

The generator produced 1536 x 1024 images. They were downscaled once to 800 x 533 (Lanczos resampling, PNG) so each file is
about 0.5 MB and the benchmarks run quickly. The originals are not kept in the repo.

## Images

All files are PNG, RGB, 800 x 533 pixels (3:2).

| File | Category (C2 list) | What is in it | Why it is useful |
|------|--------------------|---------------|------------------|
| `landscape-tower.png` | Landscape | A stone watchtower on the right third of a grassy hill, blue sky with wispy clouds, a tiny hiker on the far left of the ridge | Large low-energy areas (sky, grass) with one strong object, the layout of the Broadway Tower example in the assignment brief. The hiker is tiny, so it shows whether a seam cuts through a small object |
| `portrait-red-jacket.png` | Portrait | Head and shoulders of a person in a red jacket on the left, plain grey wall filling the right | A face is the object most visibly damaged by a bad seam. The empty wall on the right gives seams a safe path |
| `edges-glass-building.png` | Strong edges | A glass office facade in a regular grid of window frames, blue sky on both sides, tree tops at the bottom corners | Straight lines with high energy everywhere. Seams through the facade bend the lines, and seams through the sky margins are almost free |
| `person-beach.png` | A person in a scene | A person in a yellow raincoat walking on a wet beach, with sea, horizon, waves and a reflection | Horizontal bands (sky, sea, sand) with long horizontal edges at the horizon and the wave line, so it exercises **horizontal** seams. The reflection is a second, weaker copy of the subject |
| `trap-wall-door.png` | Greedy-trap candidate | A white wall with one thin dark crack near the left edge and a large flat orange door on the right | Large flat areas with one thin, high-energy crack. Intended as a case where a greedy seam, which has no look-ahead, may follow a poor path. **Whether greedy actually differs from DP here is measured by the benchmark, not assumed** |

## Prompts

Every image used this shared prefix, followed by its own prompt:

> Photorealistic photograph, natural lighting, sharp focus, shot on a DSLR camera. Wide 3:2 landscape orientation. No text, no watermark, no logos, no borders.

| File | Prompt |
|------|--------|
| `landscape-tower.png` | A lone stone watchtower standing on the right third of a green grassy hill, with a vivid blue sky and thin white clouds filling the rest of the frame. A small person stands far away on the left side of the hill. |
| `portrait-red-jacket.png` | A head-and-shoulders portrait of a smiling person in a plain red jacket, standing off-centre on the left, against a softly blurred pale grey wall. Lots of empty background on the right. |
| `edges-glass-building.png` | A modern glass office building photographed straight on, with a strict grid of windows, crisp vertical and horizontal lines, and a plain blue sky behind it. |
| `person-beach.png` | A person in a yellow raincoat walking along a wide empty beach, centred slightly right, with calm sea, wet sand and an overcast sky behind them. |
| `trap-wall-door.png` | A white wall with a single thin dark vertical crack running near the left edge and a large flat orange door on the right. Even lighting, no other details. |

## Using them

```
build/cli/seamcli.exe testdata/landscape-tower.png out.png 600 533 dp
```

Benchmarks and figures should write to `results/` and `docs/report/figures/`, not into this folder.
